# Session with Jade Matthew

> Mental health, confidence and creative coaching from Jade Matthew in London, in person and online. One to one coaching for individuals and creative people, plus coaching, workshops and public speaking training for companies.

Jade Matthew is a working actress with twenty years of screen and radio credits across the BBC, HBO, Netflix, Channel 4, ITV and Sky, and a BBC Audio Drama Award. She is Senior Audio Director at LAMDA, a clinical hypnotherapist and a Master NLP Practitioner, and has coached more than 1,000 people. Her way of working is called the Performance State Method: inner work on stress, nerves and patterns, alongside outer work on performance, creativity and productivity.

## What she helps with
- Stress, burnout, anxiety, overthinking, sleep, confidence and self worth
- Musicians, actors, writers and people in fashion: creative blocks, nerves, burnout and life on the road
- Being on camera, podcasts, interviews, panels, posting on social and launch days
- Leaders and teams: executive coaching, public speaking training and group workshops
- Keynotes, panels and interactive talks on confidence, creativity and performing under pressure
This is coaching, not medical treatment. She works alongside GPs and therapists where needed.

## Tools she uses
Clinical hypnotherapy, NLP, Neuro sessions (breathwork), anchoring, timeline work, voice and body work, rehearsal on camera, hypnosis audio, the Session app and Mara.
